commentaire: The stage 18 of the Giro d'Italia was suspended, as a result of the riders not wanting to take the start due to huge prosecution by the Italian police, which registered the teams' hotels all-night-long, seeking for forbidden products. Therefore, no CQ-points are awarded to the leader.
titre: Giro d'Italia, Stage 18 : Imperia - Sant'Anna di Vinadio (230 km)
